advisory.summary: code injection / OS command execution: the SQL Expressions feature reaches runDuckQuery, which executes attacker-controlled SQL through the DuckDB engine binary (DuckDB file functions enable LFI/RCE); the upstream fix removes the go-duck dependency and the exec sink outright

acquisition.notes: Fixed variant applying the real upstream fix (PR #94942, 'disable sql expressions', commit 6e6ed73416ebed5e92c98963937a5f349534c76a): the go-duck dependency and the runDuckQuery exec sink are deleted and /api/ds/query returns an inert 501. The advisory sink main.runDuckQuery no longer resolves anywhere in the tree.

expected_verdict.label: reasoned_not_exploitable
expected_verdict.rationale: The upstream fix removes runDuckQuery and the exec sink outright and redirects /api/ds/query to a not-implemented stub, so ResolveDependencySymbols for main.runDuckQuery resolves nothing and no ingress-to-sink path exists -- reachable_candidate flips to not_exploitable by symbol removal. Reasoned rather than proven because non-exploitability proof requires the two-trace. KnownGap: this row is surfaced in the corpus but not yet measured end-to-end -- until PLAN-020's per-language dispatch and this lane's populated symbol lists and ground truth land, the fixture Loads and Validates cleanly but the stub pipeline emits a uniform verdict, so direction/strength equality is not asserted (assertable_now=false), mirroring the symboltest harness's documented gap.
